title: coap/CMakeLists.txt at HEAD references six nonexistent sources; coap subsystem generate fails on fresh clone
description: Verified at HEAD: CMakeLists.txt:8-9 zephyr_library_sources(coap_codec.c coap_blockwise.c) and :61 coap_keys_settings.c plus gated coap_waypoints.c, coap_keys_alert.c, presence.c are all absent from the committed tree (git ls-tree confirms MISSING all six). Introduced in d76c6da69d which swept in hunks belonging to another worker's untracked WIP. CMake generate fails (cannot find source file); LICHEN_PRESENCE Kconfig (default y) references missing presence.c. Twister tests escaped because they compile .c files directly. Fix: revert the six file references and companion Kconfig hunks (waypoints/keys/msg/COAP_EXTENDED_OPTIONS_LEN_VALUE) OR land the WIP files first - re-check git status at fix time and coordinate via the owning worker's beads; then prove the fix: fresh cmake generate of the coap subsystem (host cmake or twister configure) passes at the fix commit.
close_reason: Reverted the six unlanded-WIP source references from committed coap/CMakeLists.txt (coap_codec.c, coap_blockwise.c unconditional; coap_waypoints.c, coap_keys_alert.c, coap_keys_settings.c, presence.c gated) and companion Kconfig hunks (LICHEN_COAP_WAYPOINTS, COAP_EXTENDED_OPTIONS_LEN_VALUE block, MSG select COAP_EXTENDED_OPTIONS_LEN, LICHEN_PRESENCE default-y, keys help-text sweep). Other worker's untracked WIP files untouched. Vacuous 'imply ZCBOR' (KEYS already depends on ZCBOR) deliberately NOT restored: it re-triggers the workspace zcbor dependency-loop (4.1.0 split) that breaks all lichen-module Kconfig parses locally. Commits: b82f0d24c4 + d33b6a5956 (c1a9c4ab79 repaired a stray hunk that briefly mislanded in the checkin commit). PROOF: clean worktrees at 0297a8709b vs d33b6a5956; fresh generate of coap subsystem (west build qemu_x86/atom lichen/tests/coap_client, ZEPHYR_EXTRA_MODULES=<wt>/lichen): base commit fails at generate (Cannot find source: coap_codec.c), fix commit generates and compiles to [111/192]; remaining failures are pre-existing 4.1.0-workspace incompatibilities in untouched files (coap_client.c send_mutex, lichen_util.c array-param, checkin.c stack-usage Werror) - filed separately. Twister rangetest at d33b6a5956: 1/1 configs, 6/6 cases passed.
